Eczema Topical corticosteroids have an important role in the man- agement of atopic eczema (p.1579). The least potent prep- aration that is effective should be used, combined with reg- ular use of an emollient; in mild to moderate disease the topical corticosteroid is only given for 1 to 2 weeks at a time.
